lastCompletedStory.title: Add notifyOrchestrator injectable + pure verdict-line formatter; call from loop.ts review branch

nextStoryContext: US-001 introduced: (1) formatReviewVerdictLine(round, lastVerdict) in worker-report.ts; (2) notifyOrchestrator?: (line: string) => void on RunSupervisorOptions; (3) the loop calls it in the review branch after a non-error dispatch when lastVerdict is non-null. Also: review.ts now stores FIXES_PENDING:K (with count) instead of bare FIXES_PENDING in lastVerdict. US-002 (the wiring story) can now inject a real send-keys callback via notifyOrchestrator without tmux details leaking into the loop.
